fixture.description: Test fixtures only. Never set in real places.

id.description: Unique id; must equal the folder name.

short_name.description: Short form used in headings ("Finding …") and small cards when `name` is long.

name_local.description: Name in local script (Chinese, Hangul, Japanese, Thai).

city.description: City slug; must equal the parent folder name.

category.description: Main balance category (one). `stay` (with kind Stay) is a place to sleep, not an attraction.

fame.description: How well known it is. iconic = on every top-10 list, the traveler has surely heard of it; popular = well known to anyone who researched the city; hidden = most foreign visitors never hear of it. Shown as a chip (Icon / Hidden gem); the traveler wants discovery, so be honest.

must_do.description: Claims an item of the traveler's must-do list: a `key` from config/taste.yaml (see `./atr taste`). Shows the "On your list" chip.

must_do_note.description: One line shown next to "On your list" when the page is not exactly what the traveler named (and in `./atr taste`).
examples: The viral Chongqing branch closed in 2024; this is the closest open one.

why.description: Swipe-card pitch: why the traveler should care, in one sentence.
examples: A 450-year-old classical garden that is calm and nearly empty on winter mornings.

cover.description: Image for swipe cards (media name). Defaults to the hero image.

cost.description: Typical per-person spend for one visit (ticket + must-have extras).

local.description: Typical spend for one visit in local currency (0 = free). Stay places: ONE NIGHT in the cheapest bed.

brl.description: Same amount in R$ = local × fx.rate (rounded).

fx.description: Exchange rate used for every R$ amount on this page.

rate.description: 1 unit of local currency = rate × BRL. Get it with `./atr fx CNY`.

counts_against_budget.description: Does this cost come out of the "everything else" daily budget? Default: false for food places (category food or kind Eat — meals are budgeted separately) and for stays (beds are budgeted separately), true otherwise.

when.description: Only for date-bound places (events, festivals, seasonal openings): when it happens. Checked against the trip dates in config/trip.yaml.

to.description: Last day; equal to `from` for a one-day event. Leave it out only when the end date is not announced yet (an opening date with no closing date): the page then says "From 18 Dec" and treats it as open from then on.

dates.description: Date ranges with the real year of the trip (Dec 2026 – Jan 2027).

kind.description: only (default) = it happens only on these dates ("31 Dec only") · season = open during this period ("From 20 Dec to 28 Feb") · best = the place is there all the time, the page is about these dates ("Best on 24–25 Dec").

weekly.description: Only these weekdays inside the ranges (e.g. a show every Saturday): one range for the whole period instead of one per date.

label.description: Chip text. Default is derived from the dates and the kind: "31 Dec only", "17 Dec – 21 Feb", "Saturdays, 6 Dec – 2 Jan", "Best on 24–25 Dec".

confirmed.description: false = dates expected from past years, not announced yet.

required.description: true = must book (likely turned away without); "recommended" = walk-in usually possible but booking is safer (sources disagree, sell-outs on peak days); false = no booking.

lead_days.description: Book at least this many days before the visit. Required when required is true or "recommended" (unless `deadline` is set).

lead_time.description: Human version of the lead time.

method.description: How to book. `platform` = a booking site such as Hostelworld, Booking.com or Klook (labelled with its name, not "Official website"); `phone` = by phone (a `tel:` link becomes a call button).

deadline.description: A fixed "book by" date (a lottery that closes, an advance price that ends), when that matters more than `lead_days`. The hero and the booking panel then say "Book by 30 Nov" instead of "Book N days ahead".

link.description: Main booking page. Use `links` for several channels.

url.description: The booking page; with method phone, a tel: link (tel:+6622465472) renders as a call button.

examples: Email sign-up, no Chinese phone number needed

links.description: Booking channels, best one first (e.g. a foreigner-friendly reseller plus the official channel).

rules_changed.description: Recently changed booking rules — shown as a badge so the traveler double-checks.

examples: General reservations dropped; only special exhibitions need a timed ticket.

passport.description: Needs passport number at booking / entry.

examples: Book in the official WeChat mini-program; Trip.com resells at +¥10.

winter.description: Dec–Jan specifics: winter hours, Christmas/New Year closures, festivals.
examples: Winter hours from Nov 1. Open on Jan 1. Lantern festival setup from mid-January.

address_local.description: Address in local script — shown big for taxi drivers.
examples: 上海市黄浦区安仁街218号

approximate.description: true when the pin is only near the place (the building is not on OpenStreetMap, you pinned the block or the mall). The map says "approximate location".

checked.description: The day you opened the page and confirmed the facts you used.

sources.description: At least 2 real sources you actually read.

confidence.description: How sure you are about prices/hours/booking. Be honest.

examples: Winter price not on the official site; from two recent reviews.

items.description: A page block. `type` selects the block; run `./atr blocks` for every shape.

image.description: Landscape photo ≥ 1600 px wide. Omit for a typographic (no-photo) hero.

caption.description: Shown small on the hero. Use it to be honest when the photo is not the venue itself.
examples: The street outside — no free photo of the bar exists

hook.description: One evocative line under the title. Not a repeat of `why`.
examples: A Ming-era maze of rockeries and koi ponds, hidden behind a tourist bazaar.

focus.description: Which part of the photo must stay visible when cropped: a keyword, or the focal point "x% y%" (e.g. "20% 60%" = 20% from the left, 60% from the top). On a phone the hero is taller than wide, so a landscape photo already fills its height: only the x value moves it, y has no effect, and the title covers the lower half. A subject low in a wide photo stays under the text; pick a photo with the subject in its upper half.

credit_inline.description: Show the photo credit on the hero itself (it is always in the sources footer).

time_needed.description: How long a visit takes. Required except on stay places.

best_time.description: Best time of day / week. Required except on stay places.

nearest_transit.description: Nearest metro/bus stop and exit. Defaults to location.nearest_transit.

value.description: Keep it short (≤ 28 chars reads best); put the rest in `detail`.

detail.description: Smaller second line under the value.

extra.description: Up to 3 extra facts. Do not repeat the automatic ones: Cost, Time needed, Best time, Book ahead/Booking, Getting there, Hours.

examples: Piles of porous **Taihu stone** stacked into mini mountains you can climb through.

Built in the 1500s by a retired official for his parents...

Today the garden is ringed by a bazaar.

feature.description: Show the first photo wide when the count is odd (default true).

file.description: Image name in this place's media/credits.yaml (the `file` key, no extension). Fetch with `./atr media fetch`.

examples: The zig-zag bridge at opening time

focus.description: What must stay visible when cropped: a keyword or a focal point "x% y%".

days_before.description: Days before the visit (0 = visit day).

examples: Tickets open on the official WeChat mini-program. Book with your **passport number**.

passport_note.description: Passport/real-name details, e.g. "bring the same passport you booked with".
examples: Bring the **same passport** you booked with — it is scanned at the gate.

estimate.description: A rough figure (a typical fare, a snack): shown with "≈" before both amounts.

examples: Students with an ISIC card get half price.
Enter by the **north gate**; the south side is a souvenir maze.

embed.description: Show the static map image (default true).

examples: Arrive at **08:45**; the first hour is tour-group free.

name_local.description: Name in local script, to point at on the menu.

examples: Soup dumplings; bite a hole, sip, then eat.
Picture menu available; cash or Alipay.

local.description: Price for ONE night in local currency.

note.description: When the price is from, what is included.

url.description: The date-search URL that shows this price (dates in the query string), so a reviewer can reproduce it.

rating.description: Review score with its source and the date you checked it.

reviews.description: Number of reviews behind the score.

atmosphere.description: Atmosphere / social sub-score out of 10 from the same source (e.g. Hostelworld "Atmosphere"). The traveler picks hostels to meet people.

checked.description: The day you read the score.

social.description: What makes it easy to meet people: bar, common room, events, pub crawls, family dinners.

good_to_know.description: Practical notes: check-in, lockers, curfew, noise, deposit.

q.description: The traveler's question, shortened if needed.
examples: Do I need to book with my passport?
No. In winter you can **walk in**; bring the passport anyway, it is scanned at the gate.

asked.description: The DATE the question was asked (YYYY-MM-DD, from `./atr feedback --new`), shown as "asked 21 Nov". Not the question text: that goes in `q`.

correction.description: true when this answer differs from what the game's Ask box told the traveler (see the "game answered" line in `./atr feedback --new`). Shows a small "Correction" tag.

examples: The best seat in the city is the one by the window at 6 pm.
10 min walk; go after for dinner.
Most of the visit is outdoors; pavilions are unheated.
Prices checked on the official site; hours confirmed on Dianping.

blocks.description: The page, top to bottom. Start with hero.
